**Day 1 · Module 0 · 60 minutes, self-serve, 08:00–09:00** · Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, git, GitHub CLI, Python or R, three.js

Install a terminal coding agent and use it to build, check and publish two small data apps in Python or R, each with a three.js page. Self-serve; also works as pre-work.

**Lab:** none. You work in your own terminal.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this module you can:

- Install and drive a terminal coding agent
- Build and check two small data apps with it
- Publish them with GitHub and GitHub Pages
